name: uberasm-overworld-event-exit-indicators
title: Overworld Event/Exit Indicators
description:
This piece of ASM makes tiles appear in the overworld border, to show if levels have one, two, or no exits, and also if said exits/events were triggered. Useful for tracking normal and secret exits in general.

It's recommended to use this in gamemodes D and E. Also it's currently incompatible with the 'more OW levels and events' patch.
